title: Three-rotor bombes available to Bletchley Park, December 1941 to May 1945
description: Bar chart of the number of British three-rotor bombes available: 12 in December 1941, 40 in December 1942, 72 in June 1943, 87 in December 1943, 152 in December 1944 and 155 in May 1945. Data: Wikipedia, Bombe, revision 1371956337, table of three-rotor bombes available.
heading: THREE-ROTOR BOMBES AVAILABLE
